TargetableRemarketingList.description: Contains properties of a targetable remarketing list. Remarketing enables you to create lists of users who have performed specific actions on a site, then target ads to members of those lists. This resource is a read-only view of a remarketing list to be used to facilitate targeting ads to specific lists.
